Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3 November 2025**. That's the date in Moss's 2 Nov Coastal digest ("changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03") and in your own cutover recap from 8 Dec 2025, which says "the official handoff was November 3."

For the tracker, you may want a note on the practical handover. Your recap says you kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov to finish the terminal cutover, and that Kwame "fully took over on November 22."
